trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER facebook_random_finalize_on_release AFTER UPDATE OF status, runtime_claim_token, runtime_unit_token ON public.auto_campaigns FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.runtime_claim_token IS NULL) AND (new.runtime_unit_token IS NULL) AND ((old.runtime_claim_token IS NOT NULL) OR (old.runtime_unit_token IS NOT NULL)))) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_finalize_on_release()
trigger.name: facebook_random_finalize_on_release
